title_en: Cool caves, green water — a day out of Kutaisi
description_en: Trade the city streets for limestone chambers and the green bends of the Abasha. There is time for lunch between the two, without squeezing a third attraction into the day.
details_en: A day from Kutaisi pairing the walking paths at Martvili Canyon with a guided visit inside Prometheus Cave. These are managed visitor sites rather than wilderness hikes: expect steps, handrails and other visitors. A boat ride is an optional extra only when the site permits it. Tell us whether you would prefer a longer lunch or more time for photographs, and the order of the stops can be settled around the day's admission slots.
itinerary_en:
Planning estimate: 7–8 hours from Kutaisi, including travel and lunch; the order depends on admission slots.
Morning — depart around 09:30–10:00 for Martvili. Allow about 1–1.5 hours for the walking route and, if operating and requested, the separate boat activity.
Midday — stop for lunch with enough time to sit down.
Afternoon — visit Prometheus Cave with its site guide; allow time for the entrance queue as well as the cave route.
Return to Kutaisi in the late afternoon or early evening. The confirmed plan sets the pickup and expected return window.
inclusions_en: Your quote can cover return transport from Kutaisi and a guide for the day. Ask to have the chosen site admissions itemised. The cave visit follows the visitor centre's guided route. Only the services listed in your accepted quote are included.
exclusions_en: Meals, drinks, entrance tickets and boat rides are separate unless listed in the quote. Ziplining and other adventure activities are outside this itinerary. There is no promise that either boat service will operate.
requirements_en: Bring shoes with grip, a light layer for the cave, a rain jacket and drinking water. Tell us about any difficulty using stairs before booking so we can discuss a suitable alternative. Follow the visitor centre's restrictions; boat eligibility and life jackets are checked on the day.
season_en: April–October is the main season for this combination. A cave-focused version can be considered at other times after checking site opening and weather. Rain can stop boating even when the walking areas remain open.
difficulty: Easy to moderate: steps and wet surfaces
meeting_point_en: An agreed address in Kutaisi. Arrive in Kutaisi before the tour day; a flight arrival needs a separately timed plan.
weather_en: Confirm both sites are admitting visitors before departure. Martvili boating stops in rain or snow; the cave boat can stop when water rises. If the canyon closes, agree a shorter cave-and-city day with revised costs, or reschedule. If severe weather closes both sites or affects the roads, postpone; an underground venue is not a guarantee of access during a storm.
walking_en: Short walks spread through the day, with numerous steps and potentially slippery surfaces. Allow roughly 2–3 hours on foot including pauses; the guide can discuss how much walking suits your group.
driving_en: Allow approximately 3–4 hours in the vehicle across the full Kutaisi–Martvili–Prometheus–Kutaisi loop. This is a planning allowance, with queues, traffic and road conditions adding time.
operator_notes: Draft route for owner review. Confirm Kutaisi vehicle/guide availability, admission slots and current APA rules before publication or quoting. Source ticket fees differ from competitor fees; do not import either as a fixed package price. APA gives Martvili an April–October active season, rain/snow boat restrictions and a 700 m walking circuit; Prometheus has a roughly one-hour visitor route and high-water boat closures. The longer pacing and 09:30–10:00 start are our planning choices. Agree alternative costs rather than substituting silently. Check site closures again on the morning of travel.

title_en: Into Svaneti — Zugdidi, the Enguri and the mountain road
description_en: The road climbs slowly out of the lowlands. Stop for the Dadiani story in Zugdidi, stretch your legs by the Enguri, then follow the river towards Mestia.
details_en: Make the journey north part of the trip. Start in Zugdidi with either the Dadiani palace museum or the neighbouring garden, leave room for a simple lunch, and continue towards Mestia with a brief Enguri viewpoint stop where parking and access are safe. This is a one-way touring day, ending at your accommodation in Mestia. A Kutaisi start can be arranged as a longer version. Dam interiors and boat tours need separate arrangements and are not assumed stops.
itinerary_en:
Planning estimate: 5–6 hours from Zugdidi; allow 7–9 hours for a separately arranged Kutaisi start.
Morning — meet in Zugdidi. Choose the palace museum or a garden walk according to opening hours and your interests; allow around one hour.
Before the climb — take a lunch break, then head towards the Enguri. Stop briefly at a suitable public viewpoint if conditions permit.
Afternoon — continue up the valley with a rest stop as needed. Aim to reach Mestia in daylight.
If starting in Kutaisi, leave early and allow a separate 2–2.5-hour planning window to reach Zugdidi. Late arrivals need a direct-transfer plan instead.
inclusions_en: Ask for a quote covering the one-way vehicle, driver and the agreed sightseeing stops. A separate guide and museum admission can be added if requested and confirmed. The accepted quote sets the scope and finish address.
exclusions_en: Lunch, museum or garden admission, a separate guide, accommodation and onward travel are excluded unless itemised. Enguri dam interiors and lake boat trips are not part of the standard plan.
requirements_en: Provide your pickup address, luggage details and arrival time. Bring water and a layer for the change in temperature as the road climbs. Tell us if winding roads are uncomfortable for you so we can discuss breaks. Station pickups require a confirmed train time and enough daylight for the chosen stops.
season_en: April–October suits the longer sightseeing version. Travel can be considered at other times, but short daylight and winter road conditions may require a direct transfer or a different date.
meeting_point_en: An agreed address in Zugdidi, or the railway station after the arrival time is confirmed. Kutaisi pickup changes both the timing and quote.
weather_en: Check restrictions on the Zugdidi–Jvari–Mestia road before setting off. Snow, heavy rain, rockfall or poor visibility can delay or stop the journey. Skip exposed viewpoints and agree a direct journey when the road is open but sightseeing is unsuitable. If the road is closed or the driver cannot safely proceed, postpone and agree an overnight or alternative pickup plan; never promise arrival regardless of conditions.
walking_en: Allow around 1–1.5 hours of gentle walking and standing across the selected cultural visit and viewpoints. Museum steps and garden surfaces vary; access needs should be discussed in advance.
driving_en: Allow 3–4 hours driving from Zugdidi to Mestia in ordinary conditions, plus the selected stops. A Kutaisi start adds approximately 2–2.5 hours to the plan. These are buffers for planning, not a guaranteed arrival time.
operator_notes: Owner to confirm driver, suitable vehicle, luggage capacity and museum/garden opening before quoting. GNTA describes Zugdidi–Mestia at about three hours; use a wider operating allowance and daylight margin. GNTA places the palace and adjacent garden in Zugdidi and Enguri on the route north. Do not promise a dam interior visit or boat without a confirmed operator. Establish a latest sightseeing start time for the season. Check Roads Department restrictions the day before and on departure day. Do not combine a late train pickup with all stops by default.

title_en: From Svan towers to the Black Sea
description_en: Leave the cold mountain air behind and follow the valleys down to Batumi. A proper stop for food, a chance to stretch, and the sea at the end of the road.
details_en: A one-way road journey from Mestia to Batumi, with sensible breaks along the way. It works well after several days in Svaneti: finish walking, sleep in Mestia, then set off for the coast the following morning. Share your destination address and luggage needs so the right vehicle can be quoted. If you would like to travel in the other direction, ask for a separately confirmed Batumi-to-Mestia plan.
itinerary_en:
Planning estimate: 6–7 hours including ordinary rest stops; difficult weather or traffic can take longer.
Morning — pickup from the agreed Mestia address after breakfast. Descend the valley towards Zugdidi.
On the road — stop for a meal and stretching at a suitable place, keeping the journey moving without rushing.
Afternoon — continue along the western lowlands to the agreed Batumi address.
Plan to sleep in Batumi before an onward flight rather than relying on a tight same-day connection.
inclusions_en: Your quote can cover a private one-way vehicle, driver and agreed rest stops between the confirmed addresses. Vehicle size, luggage allowance and any extra stops must be included in the accepted quote.
exclusions_en: Meals, attraction visits, accommodation, guided sightseeing and waiting beyond the agreed plan are separate. Airport waiting or a different drop-off address must be discussed before confirmation.
requirements_en: Send pickup and drop-off addresses, passenger and luggage details, and any child-seat or access needs. Carry drinking water and keep a warmer layer handy for the mountain section. Allow room in your schedule for road delays.
season_en: Available to discuss throughout the year, subject to road and vehicle checks. June–September is the natural pairing for a mountain-and-coast holiday; travel outside those months needs the same road assessment and may take longer.
meeting_point_en: Your confirmed pickup address in Mestia. Finish at the agreed Batumi address; airport transfer timing and waiting require a specific quote.
weather_en: Proceed only after the mountain road is checked and the driver accepts the conditions. Snow, heavy rain or restrictions may mean a later departure, an extra night or postponement. There is no useful shortcut around a closed mountain section. Keep the following flight or long-distance connection on a separate day.
walking_en: Only short walks at rest stops; tell us if you need step-free stops or help with luggage before the vehicle is confirmed.
driving_en: Most of the day is spent in the vehicle. The 6–7-hour planning window includes breaks but not exceptional road delays; coastal traffic can also affect the final section.
operator_notes: Do not seed a fare, capacity or guaranteed schedule. Confirm driver, vehicle, rest plan, luggage and fatigue limits for the whole journey. GNTA gives roughly six hours from Batumi to Mestia; Budget Georgia lists a five-hour private and six-hour bus example. Our wider window adds rest time. Treat both as route-feasibility evidence, not our service promise. Review road restrictions and forecast before acceptance and departure. Recommend Batumi accommodation before onward flights without representing it as booked.

title_en: A second mountain chapter — three days in Kazbegi
description_en: Give Kazbegi more than a windscreen visit. Sleep beneath the mountains, see Gergeti when the clouds allow, and leave a day for a valley walk at your own pace.
details_en: This eastern extension begins and ends in Tbilisi, with two nights in Stepantsminda. Travel from Svaneti is a separate journey: be in Tbilisi before day one. The plan combines the Georgian Military Highway, Gergeti Trinity Church and a day kept for a modest valley walk. Juta is one option when its road and trail are suitable. This is a walking and sightseeing trip, with no glacier crossing, high-pass traverse or attempt on Mount Kazbek.
itinerary_en:
Planning outline: three days and two nights, with the walking day adjusted to conditions.
Day 1 — leave Tbilisi in the morning. Stop at Ananuri, take a lunch break, and continue to Stepantsminda. Visit Gergeti that afternoon if access, weather and daylight allow; otherwise leave it for a later window. Overnight in Stepantsminda.
Day 2 — if Juta is accessible, take a moderate out-and-back valley walk, with a 3–4-hour walking budget and a turnaround chosen for the group. Do not continue over Chaukhi Pass or onto a glacier. If unsuitable, choose a safe lower valley walk or a quieter town and cultural day. Second night in Stepantsminda.
Day 3 — a relaxed morning, or the postponed Gergeti visit if suitable, then return to Tbilisi with a lunch and rest break. Allow 3–4 hours or more for the road journey, excluding stops.
inclusions_en: Ask for a quote covering road transport, the agreed walking guide and two nights in Stepantsminda. The quote should name the accommodation, room arrangement and any meals or local vehicle changes included. All services depend on confirmation for your dates.
exclusions_en: Travel from Mestia to Tbilisi, flights, meals, entrance fees and accommodation outside the two agreed nights are separate unless listed. Mountaineering, glacier equipment, paragliding, ski activities and a Chaukhi Pass crossing are outside this plan.
requirements_en: Be in Tbilisi before day one. Bring walking shoes or boots with grip, waterproof layers, warm clothing, sun protection and water. Tell us how far you usually walk and any access needs; the day-two route should fit your group rather than a fixed distance. Cold evenings are possible even in summer.
season_en: June–September is the core walking season. May or October needs a freshly checked, usually lower-level programme. Snow-free access and clear mountain views are never guaranteed by the month alone.
difficulty: Moderate optional walking; route adapted to group
meeting_point_en: An agreed Tbilisi address on day one. This is not a day trip from Mestia; allow separate travel to Tbilisi before the extension starts.
weather_en: Check the Gudauri–Kobi corridor, Gergeti access and any Juta approach before committing to that day's route. Road closure, snow, lightning, poor visibility or an unsafe trail means a change of plan. Replace the Juta walk with a suitable lower walk or cultural day only after the guide checks it. If the main highway is closed, postpone or agree a Tbilisi-area alternative; never promise Kazbegi access regardless of the forecast.
walking_en: Day two allows roughly 3–4 hours of walking with pauses, shortened as needed. Expect uneven ground and uphill sections. Other days have short sightseeing walks. Exact trail, distance and turnaround are agreed after checking conditions and ability.
driving_en: Budget 3–4 hours or more each way between Tbilisi and Stepantsminda before sightseeing and traffic delays. Local road time on day two depends on the chosen valley and access; avoid adding a second distant hike.
operator_notes: Owner review required before activation: this needs confirmed eastern-Georgia driver/guide and accommodation arrangements, not an implied existing partner. June–September is supported by GNTA outdoor-season advice; the three-day pacing and walking budget are our design. The Roads Department March 2026 all-vehicle avalanche closure is historical evidence of access risk, not today's road status. Check current restrictions and actual Juta road/trail condition. Do not substitute a waterfall path as an automatic safe alternative in ice or heavy rain. Price each component, agree contingencies and preserve a separate Svaneti-to-Tbilisi travel day.

description_en: Walk Sighnaghi before the day gets hot, look out over the Alazani Valley, and leave enough time to sit down properly. Wine is part of the story; so are bread, gardens and the towns between the vineyards.
details_en: A slower eastern-Georgia trip from Tbilisi, with a night in Sighnaghi rather than a race back after lunch. Begin with Bodbe and Sighnaghi, then spend the following day around Telavi and one selected estate, museum or cellar. Wine visits are optional and booked with an agreed host. If you prefer to skip alcohol, the towns, food and cultural stops still make a full two days. Travel from Mestia to Tbilisi is arranged separately before this trip.
itinerary_en:
Planning outline: two days and one night, with host appointments and lunch setting the pace.
Day 1 — morning departure from Tbilisi; allow 2–2.5 hours for the first approach to the Sighnaghi area with ordinary road buffers. Visit Bodbe, walk Sighnaghi and pause for lunch. An afternoon cellar visit can be added if requested and confirmed. Overnight in Sighnaghi.
Day 2 — head towards Telavi for time in town and one selected estate, museum or cellar in the area. Have lunch before returning to Tbilisi. Choose the return road according to conditions and allow a generous afternoon travel window.
Keep the programme to one or two pre-arranged wine visits across the whole trip, leaving time for the places between them.
inclusions_en: Your quote can cover the vehicle, driver or guide, one night in Sighnaghi and the visits you choose. Ask for accommodation, meals and any tasting fees to be listed individually. Only confirmed hosts and services appear in the final plan.
exclusions_en: Travel from Svaneti, extra hotel nights, meals, museum admissions and tastings are separate unless specified. Grape picking, a family feast or a harvest celebration cannot be assumed; these need a named host and an agreed date.
requirements_en: Be in Tbilisi before day one. Bring comfortable shoes, water, sun protection and clothing suitable for monastery visits. Share dietary and access needs when planning. Tell us whether you want wine visits, an alcohol-free trip or a mixture of interests.
season_en: April–June and September–October are the preferred windows for a comfortable cultural trip. Summer needs earlier walks and shaded breaks. Harvest visits sometimes fit autumn, but the host and the grapes determine the date.
meeting_point_en: An agreed address in Tbilisi. Arrive there before day one; this itinerary does not include the long journey from Mestia.
weather_en: In hot weather, walk early and replace the hottest outdoor period with a longer lunch or an indoor visit. Rain may shorten town and garden walks. If the Gombori road is icy or otherwise unsuitable, use a suitable lower route only after checking conditions, with extra time allowed. Severe weather can mean postponement. A confirmed cellar or museum visit can replace an outdoor stop by agreement.
walking_en: Mostly short town, garden and cultural-site walks. Allow about 1–2 hours spread over each day, with cobblestones, slopes and some steps. Accessibility differs by host and site and should be checked before booking.
driving_en: Several road legs across the two days, rather than one continuous journey. Plan roughly 2–2.5 hours for the first Tbilisi–Sighnaghi approach and a generous afternoon for the final return. Exact road time depends on selected hosts, return route and traffic.
operator_notes: Owner must establish and confirm local driver/guide, accommodation and any cellar or estate arrangements before activating. GNTA's Sighnaghi page gives about 1h40 from Tbilisi; our approach allowance includes margin. Spring and autumn preference follows GNTA cultural-season guidance. Harvest starts in Kakheti around September but varies; do not promise participation without host confirmation. Two-day pacing, overnight location and limit on tasting stops are original planning decisions. Quote separately and do not imply alcohol or food is automatically included.

title_en: Canyons first, Svaneti next — five days in the west
description_en: Start below the mountains, with a cave and a canyon, then give Svaneti the days it deserves. Three nights in Mestia leave room for Ushguli, a local walk and the weather changing its mind.
details_en: Begin after a night's rest in Kutaisi, not straight off a flight. The route spends its first full day around Martvili and Prometheus, then moves to Mestia for three nights. One day is set aside for Ushguli and another stays flexible for a local outing. Return to Kutaisi on the fifth day, ideally with another night there before flying. The four nights during the itinerary are one in Kutaisi and three in Mestia; the arrival night before day one and any final airport night are extra arrangements.
itinerary_en:
Planning outline: five full days and four nights during the route. Be in Kutaisi and rested before day one.
Day 1 — the Kutaisi cave-and-canyon day, allowing 7–8 hours with lunch and no airport collection attached. Overnight in Kutaisi.
Day 2 — drive to Mestia with rest stops, allowing a 5–6-hour transfer window in ordinary conditions. A short town walk can follow if there is time and energy; no major hike is planned. First night in Mestia.
Day 3 — an Ushguli village day, with an early start, modest walking and enough time for the road both ways. No Shkhara glacier walk is automatically added. Second night in Mestia.
Day 4 — a local walk or viewpoint outing chosen for the group and forecast, or a cultural day in Mestia. This day can swap with day three if that gives a better weather window. Third night in Mestia.
Day 5 — return to Kutaisi with breaks. Plan an additional Kutaisi night before an onward flight rather than a tight connection.
inclusions_en: Request a quote covering the full road route, the guides required for selected walks and four nights: one in Kutaisi and three in Mestia. Accommodation names, room arrangements, meals and admissions should all be confirmed in the quote. The day-four activity is agreed before booking or changed together if conditions require.
exclusions_en: Flights, the arrival night before day one, any final Kutaisi night, meals, admission tickets and boat services are separate unless listed. No particular hotel or guesthouse is guaranteed before confirmation. Glacier travel, long high-altitude hikes and a return via the Ushguli–Lentekhi road are outside the standard route.
requirements_en: Arrive in Kutaisi before the itinerary starts. Bring walking shoes, waterproof and warm layers, water and sun protection. Share your walking experience, room needs and luggage details. Keep arrival and departure connections flexible enough for mountain-road delays.
season_en: June–September is the core window. Late May or October requires a revised plan based on snow, road access and daylight; higher viewpoints are never automatic inclusions.
duration: 5 days / 4 nights; arrive in Kutaisi beforehand
meeting_point_en: An agreed Kutaisi address on the morning of day one. An overnight in Kutaisi before the start is required for this full-day programme and is outside the four itinerary nights unless added to the quote.
weather_en: Check sites and roads before each day. Boat closures do not cancel a suitable walking visit, but site closure requires an agreed replacement or revised cost. In Svaneti, swap the Ushguli and local days if useful. If the Ushguli road is unsafe, use an agreed Mestia cultural or lower-level day; do not take a high-pass shortcut. If the main road to Svaneti is closed, agree an extra Kutaisi stay, a revised western itinerary or postponement before proceeding.
walking_en: Day one involves visitor-site steps. The Ushguli day keeps to village walks; day four's walking effort is agreed for the group, from a gentle town day to a moderate local outing. No fixed long hike or glacier approach is included by default.
driving_en: Two substantial Kutaisi–Mestia travel days, each planned with a 5–6-hour allowance and breaks. The Ushguli excursion is another full mountain-road day with its own local timing check. Conditions may extend any of these windows.
operator_notes: Owner-review package requiring confirmed vehicles, guides and all rooms. Four route nights are exactly Kutaisi x1 + Mestia x3; a pre-trip Kutaisi night is mandatory for the stated D1 and must be separately quoted or explicitly added. Do not let an airport arrival silently become a full canyon day. Five-day sequencing, buffers and flexible D4 are original planning choices. GNTA supports the road travel scale; TravelMestia shows a shorter multi-day Kutaisi/Svaneti market example but is not a supplier commitment. Use the maintained Ushguli local preset for detailed operational checks. Restrict standard return to Mestia–Zugdidi–Kutaisi; do not promise the seasonal Lentekhi route. Agree costs of weather-driven changes before guests accept.

title_en: Kutaisi to Mestia — leave the driving to someone else
description_en: Settle in, watch the lowlands give way to the Enguri valley, and arrive with energy left for Mestia. This is a transfer with proper breaks, not a day of hurried attraction stops.
details_en: A straightforward one-way road transfer from an agreed Kutaisi address to Mestia. The route uses the main approach through Zugdidi and the Enguri valley, with rest stops chosen along the way. Airport pickup is possible to discuss once your flight time, luggage and daylight are known. If you want a museum visit or longer sightseeing stops, choose a separately timed touring day instead.
itinerary_en:
Planning estimate: allow 5–6 hours including ordinary rest breaks from central Kutaisi, and more if weather or traffic intervenes.
Meet at the confirmed address and load luggage.
Travel towards Zugdidi, stopping to stretch or eat at a suitable point.
Continue up the Enguri valley to the agreed Mestia drop-off.
The confirmed pickup time should allow daylight for the mountain section where practical. Late flights may be better followed by a Kutaisi overnight and a morning departure.
inclusions_en: Ask for a quote covering the one-way vehicle, driver and agreed rest stops. It should state pickup and drop-off addresses, vehicle and luggage arrangements, and any airport waiting included.
exclusions_en: Meals, accommodation, guided visits and attraction admissions are not part of a simple transfer. Airport waiting beyond the agreed allowance or a changed pickup/drop-off needs a revised arrangement.
requirements_en: Send your pickup address or flight number, passenger count, luggage details and any child-seat or access needs. Keep a warm layer and water within reach. Avoid arranging a fixed activity immediately after the estimated arrival.
season_en: Discuss dates throughout the year, subject to road, weather and vehicle checks. Winter travel needs more time and the appropriate vehicle setup; this is not an all-weather departure guarantee.
meeting_point_en: A confirmed central Kutaisi address. Kutaisi airport collection requires flight details and a separate pickup/waiting agreement.
weather_en: Check the main Svaneti approach before departure. Road closure, heavy snow or unsafe conditions can require postponement and a Kutaisi overnight. If delayed but still safe to proceed, agree a revised arrival window. Do not use the seasonal Ushguli–Lentekhi road as a default workaround.
walking_en: Only short walks at rest stops. Discuss step-free access and luggage assistance before the vehicle is assigned.
driving_en: Plan for most of a day in transit, with a 5–6-hour ordinary-condition allowance from central Kutaisi. Airport location, roadworks, rest needs and mountain conditions can change the total.
operator_notes: Pure transfer preset with no seeded fare, driver or capacity. Verify the specific vehicle, passenger/luggage fit, child seats, flight waiting policy and driver duty plan. GNTA estimates central Kutaisi to Mestia at about five hours; the 5–6-hour window is our allowance and not a timetable. Check current road restrictions and forecast when confirming and again before departure. Prefer a daytime mountain leg for late flight arrivals. Winter tyres/chains and any legally required equipment must be checked against current road requirements by the operator; do not hard-code a legal seasonal rule from memory.
